newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone troops retreat from airport - army.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone troops retreat from airport - army.

text.p: Sierra Leone's army government said on Thursday its forces had pulled back from Freetown international airport after heavy clashes with Nigerian troops there.
Heavy shelling overnight sparked panic in the capital, where Nigerian-led West African forces are confronting coup leaders who toppled the elected president, Ahmad Tejan Kabbah, on May 25.
Government chief of staff Brigadier Samuel Koroma told Reuters that Nigerian troops holding the airport bombarded his forces with mortar fire for more than six hours up to dawn on Thursday.
"Our forces have been pulled back to Port Loko about 35 miles (55 km) from the airport," Koroma said.
He did not give the position of government troops when the clash broke out, saying only that "our men had no contact with the Nigerians yesterday".
